hover_electrical_power_w.notes: Phase 2 AuthoritativeHoverModel momentum theory & rotor disk area.

transition_energy_wh.notes: Phase 3 AuthoritativeTransitionModel flight corridor numerical integration.

cruise_electrical_power_w.notes: Fixed-Wing backend cruise propulsion shaft power / motor efficiency.

avionics_power_w.notes: Autopilot, telemetry, sensors, and BEC auxiliary load.

payload_power_w.notes: Payload sensor and gimbal stabilization power draw.

reserve_fraction.notes: Reserve battery energy buffer (Torq Wings project requirement: min 20%).

usable_dod_fraction.notes: Maximum allowable depth of discharge to protect cell cycle longevity.

specific_energy_wh_kg.notes: Gravimetric energy density for preliminary battery mass sizing.

battery_mass_convergence.notes: Multidisciplinary structural mass synthesis & closed-loop MTOW iteration.

engineering_assumptions: Aircraft weight derived via W = mass * g (g = 9.80665 m/s²).
Stall speed derived via V_stall = sqrt(2*W / (rho*S*CL_max)) = 67.00 km/h (CL_max=1.40).
warnings: Preferred transition speed (65.0 km/h) is below stall speed (67.0 km/h). Clamped to minimum safe conversion speed (80.4 km/h).

ruddervator_geometry.mixer_convention: delta_left = delta_e - delta_r; delta_right = delta_e + delta_r

trim_analysis.reason: All design conditions trim within maximum ruddervator deflection limits

control_authority.vtol_multirotor_authority_distinction: Fixed-wing aerodynamic surfaces (ruddervators, ailerons) provide cruise control. Multirotor lift motors provide hover/low-speed pitch/roll/yaw via differential thrust.

wing_mac_m.notes: Calculated via canonical trapezoidal integration formula

wing_le_x_m.notes: Wing leading edge position on fuselage

wing_ac_x_m.notes: Subsonic wing aerodynamic center at quarter-chord of MAC

total_vtail_area_m2.notes: True sum of left and right tail panel planforms (zero double-counting)

v_tail_dihedral_deg.notes: Dihedral angle theta = -arctan(sqrt(Sv / Sh)) for inverted V-tail

total_ruddervator_area_m2.notes: Total movable control surface area on both inverted V-tail panels

total_aileron_area_m2.notes: Both sides aileron area spanning 65% to 95% semispan

neutral_point_x_m.notes: Calculated from wing AC, tail volume, lift-curve slopes, downwash, and dynamic pressure

static_margin_target_min.notes: Minimum static margin guideline from default mass constraints and aerospace literature (heuristic, not certified TorqWings requirement)

static_margin_target_max.notes: Upper bound static margin guideline to avoid excessive trim drag and control heaviness (heuristic, not certified TorqWings requirement)

pitch_damping_c_mq.notes: Dynamic pitch damping rate derivative deferred to Phase 7 6-DOF simulation (not silently replaced by zero)

directional_stability_c_n_beta.notes: C_n_beta = V_v * C_L_alpha,v * eta_v + C_n_beta,fuse (fuselage term is CONFIGURABLE_ASSUMPTION)

lateral_stability_c_l_beta.notes: C_l_beta = C_l_beta,high_wing + C_l_beta,geom (high-wing term is CONFIGURABLE_ASSUMPTION)

control_derivative_c_l_delta_a.notes: C_l_delta_a strip integration from inboard to outboard stations

cg_forward_limit_x_m.notes: Forward CG limit for approach trim authority

cg_aft_limit_x_m.notes: Aft CG limit providing at least 5.0% MAC static margin (derived from CONFIGURABLE_ASSUMPTION guideline; not a certified operational envelope)

engineering_assumptions: Inverted V-tail dihedral angle derived from projected horizontal and vertical tail requirements.
Helmbold 3D lift-curve slope applied for rectangular/tapered wing planform.
Tail efficiency eta_t = 0.95 reflecting clean twin-boom pusher prop clearance.
Quasi-steady trim analysis evaluated at cruise, approach (1.25 V_stall), and transition handover.
Fixed-wing aerodynamic surface control is segregated from VTOL multirotor differential thrust.
